decisions.reason: The click-in track adapter is an incremental extension of the established track system and the industry is growing, so its results likely meet the firm's aspiration and management keeps it.
This LED luminaire is close to the firm's core offer, and with no evidence of shortfall and a growing market, it likely meets aspirations and is kept.
Although the home automation server box is a more complex extension, it builds on the firm's existing home automation offer, and slack plus the absence of shortfall favour keeping it.
The luminaire family is close to the established offer, and in a growing industry its results likely meet aspirations, so management keeps it.
